issues.title: Card multi-drag disabled after first drop (sensor unmount bug)
issues.description:
### Bug Summary
Users were unable to drag a card a second time after moving it once. Subsequent drag attempts failed to lift the card.

### Root Cause
Deleting `optimisticUpdates[issueId]` synchronously in the `finally` block caused a momentary DOM unmount/remount (reverting status for ~25ms before Dexie live query updated). This destroyed `@hello-pangea/dnd` internal draggable sensor bindings.

### Resolution
1. Implemented a reactive `useEffect` that only evicts optimistic state once the underlying Dexie query confirms the new status.
2. Filtered out `@hello-pangea/dnd` elements from board mouse-panning handlers.
3. Removed CSS transitions from dragging wrappers.

subtasks.title: Diagnose draggable sensor destruction on second drag
Implement reactive optimistic update eviction in KanbanBoard
Exclude dnd draggable and handle attributes from board panning
Verify continuous multi-drop across all 4 columns

comments.author: VY
comments.content: Verified: Cards can now be dragged continuously any number of times between all columns.

issues.title: Column droppable height collapse & missing blue drop zone in short columns
issues.description:
### Bug Summary
Dragging tasks into short columns (e.g. In Progress with 1 task) failed when dragging from lower sections of tall columns. The blue drop zone only showed for the top 140px and vanished below existing cards.

### Root Cause
Under CSS flexbox, flex column children with `height: 100%` collapse to `height: auto` if the parent container uses `min-height`. When scrolled down, the short column droppable DOM element was scrolled off the top of the viewport and did not exist in the lower area.

### Resolution
1. Computed dynamic `calculatedMinHeight` in `KanbanBoard` using `ResizeObserver` on `boardRef.current.scrollHeight` and card counts.
2. Injected `style={{ minHeight }}` directly onto the `Droppable` DOM container so drop target covers the entire board height.
3. Enhanced hover indicator with blue dashed border and shadow ring.

subtasks.title: Inspect droppable bounding box collapse under CSS flexbox
Implement dynamic ResizeObserver scrollHeight calculation
Inject inline minHeight onto Droppable ref in BoardColumn
Verify dropping at bottom of short columns successfully appends task

comments.author: VY
comments.content: Fixed: Blue drop target spans full board height across all columns.

issues.title: Implement active edge auto-scrolling loop during card dragging
issues.description:
### Feature Summary
When dragging cards up or down across tall columns, the board should automatically scroll so cards can be moved between distant positions.

### Implementation
1. Removed CSS `scroll-smooth` on the board scroll container which previously conflicted with frame-by-frame drag scrolling.
2. Added `requestAnimationFrame` loop on `window` mousemove events while `isDraggingCardRef.current` is true.
3. Computes vertical edge proximity (top/bottom 100px) and horizontal edge proximity (left/right 80px) to scroll smoothly with velocity proportional to edge distance.

subtasks.title: Remove scroll-smooth from scroll container during drag
Create requestAnimationFrame mousemove edge watcher
Support vertical and horizontal proportional scrolling speed
Add mouseup safety fallback handler

comments.author: VY
comments.content: Feature complete: Board smoothly auto-scrolls when dragging cards to any edge.
